title: Sanction historical governance reconciliation for COMPAT-CAD-009
problem: COMPAT-CAD-009 has two immutable historical governance-record defects: the APPROVED -> MERGED transition was timestamped 2026-09-06T12:07:25Z before the APPROVED decision recorded at 2026-09-06T12:08:00Z, and therefore the ledger shows MERGED entered without a prior approved decision. The original events must remain unchanged and be reconciled explicitly rather than rewritten.
evidence: Governance validation run 34032828855 identified COMPAT-CAD-009 temporal-ordering and MERGED-entry decision failures.
The immutable COMPAT-CAD-009 governance record records transition #12 APPROVED -> MERGED at 2026-09-06T12:07:25Z and DEC-002 at 2026-09-06T12:08:00Z.
Physical product merge 066be5fc098443e21263ed57d21788849a875195 is confirmed by GitHub PR #14 and exact merge-triggered CI/browser evidence.

Existing ARCH-WF-002 reconciliation controls permit only narrowly enumerated historical unauthorized-role, temporal-ordering and missing-prior-approved-decision defects; VERIFIED evidence and revision binding remain non-waivable.
impact: No architecture or validator semantics change. This ACR only sanctions an explicit historical reconciliation record for COMPAT-CAD-009 so the genuine physical merge and later approval recording order remain auditable without rewriting immutable events or weakening future lifecycle rules.
alternatives: Rewrite the historical merge or approval timestamps: rejected because that would falsify the audit trail.
Modify or weaken the validator to ignore this work item: rejected because it would reduce governance integrity.
Waive the verification evidence requirements: rejected because post-merge evidence is independently complete and must remain subject to normal verification rules.
recommendation: Register ACR-006 through its normal PROPOSED -> ENDORSED -> APPROVED lifecycle, then stage and decide REC-COMPAT-CAD-009 naming exactly the two historical defects. Preserve all original transition and decision records and require the ordinary MERGED -> VERIFIED evidence gate.
migration_plan: Create this ACR as PROPOSED, obtain Architect endorsement and Product Owner approval, create REC-COMPAT-CAD-009 as STAGED with verbatim defect citations, then record the Architect reconciliation decision. Restore missing historical evidence EV-001 through EV-004 in the CC009 work-item record, add the exact post-merge CI/browser evidence, and perform the normal Architect MERGED -> VERIFIED transition. Rerun governance validation after the complete record settles.
compatibility: Architecture v1.1 remains frozen. The reconciliation affects only the historical CC009 governance ledger and does not change the legal lifecycle, implementation scope, evidence policy, benchmark policy, or future work-item authorization rules.
security_impact: The ACR and reconciliation are repository-backed, role-restricted and auditable. No credentials or privileged operational data are introduced, and no mechanism is created to bypass implementation-agent approval or verification boundaries.
provenance: Architect verification of the physical CC009 merge exposed an immutable bookkeeping-order defect during deterministic governance validation; the existing ARCH-WF-002 reconciliation mechanism is the prescribed remedy.

review.rationale: The reconciliation is limited to the two observed historical validator violations and does not weaken future governance or verification rules.

approval.rationale: ACR-006 is necessary and sufficient to sanction the exact historical bookkeeping defects while preserving immutable event facts and all non-waivable verification requirements.
